data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $466.959m. During 2020 the Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of $63.984m (13.7% of opening gross reserves) in the movement in prior year provisions per the technical provisions note. The report describes an extensive Q4 2020 reserve review and also references multiple 2020 loss events (North Atlantic hurricane activity, a U.S. derecho, Californian wildfires, the Beirut explosion and COVID-19) and RDS scenario impacts; these factors, together with changes in reinsurer recoveries, contributed to reserve movements. The gross premium book for 2020 was $313.569m, with the majority written as reinsurance acceptances and material exposure in property and aviation-related classes.

Based on the July 2020 Lloyd's RDS submission using version 17 of RMS, the largest RDS on a gross basis was for a North-East USA windstorm event for $265.6m [unaudited]. The largest event net of reinsurance recoveries and reinstatement costs was an Aviation Collision event for $72.9 [unaudited].

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary values are taken from the Syndicate annual accounts presented in $'000. Opening reserves and prior-year movement are the GROSS figures from Note 18 'Technical provisions' (converted to millions). There is a narrative statement describing a 'favourable improvement' in 2018/prior reserves, which appears to conflict with the gross 'Change in prior year provisions' table row (a gross strengthening of $63.984k). Reinsurance to close (RITC) and reinsurance recoveries are present in the filings and may distort comparisons; the 2018 closed year RITC elements are shown elsewhere in the accounts. Where per-line prior-year movements are not provided, lob_movements are conservatively set with null amounts and medium confidence.
